name: Highlife sax solo line
desc: The legato alternative to the horn stabs: a wavetable alto-sax singing a melodic line that climbs through the I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) changes, shadowed an octave below by an off(1/8) second horn, with tape delay, room and a slow filter sweep. Peak breaks into fast altissimo runs.

code.full: note('<[b4 ~ e5 g#5 ~ b5 ~ g#5 e5 ~ f#5 ~] [g#4 ~ c#5 e5 ~ g#5 ~ e5 c#5 ~ d#5 ~] [e5 ~ a5 c#6 ~ e6 ~ c#6 a5 ~ b5 ~] [f#5 ~ b5 d#6 ~ f#6 ~ d#6 b5 ~ c#6 ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('wt_altosax').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).attack(.03).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.12).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(-12)).gain(${gain}*.55)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note('<[b4 e5 g#5 b5 e6 b5 g#5 e5 f#5 g#5 b5 e5] [g#4 c#5 e5 g#5 c#6 g#5 e5 c#5 d#5 e5 g#5 c#5] [e5 a5 c#6 e6 a6 e6 c#6 a5 b5 c#6 e6 a5] [f#5 b5 d#6 f#6 b6 f#6 d#6 b5 c#6 d#6 f#6 b5]>').add(note(${root})).s('wt_altosax').lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.4).slow(12)).attack(.02).decay(.14).sustain(.3).release(.08).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(-12)).gain(${gain}*.55)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(5).play()
